315:246.en: 「You won't get a turn to attack!」

315:378.en: 「I'll cut you up and sell the parts!」

315:415.en: 「Don't act tough if you know\nwhat's good for you!」

315:497.en: 「Nobody in this world can beat us!」

315:540.en: 「Bad luck, getting spotted\nby the likes of us!」

315:589.en: 「My life matters more than $$ラケージ$$!\nRun for it!」

315:741.en: 「The sunset will light up your skull!」

315:776.en: 「Don't think you can beat us at sea!」

315:866.en: 「Don't you dare look down on\nthe $$ラケージ$$ Pirates!」

315:921.en: 「Boys! Don't you dare disgrace\n$$ラケージ$$!」

315:978.en: 「Anyone who defies $$ラケージ$$\nneeds a good punishment, huh!」

315:1816.en: 「Even if it's a huge $$ユンボロ$$,\nit depends where you aim...!」

315:1867.en: 「N-No way, that guy...!\nIs that the rumored $$ガンダム$$!?」

315:1918.en: 「To see the legendary $$ガンダム$$\nwith my own eyes!」

315:2232.en: 「There's a bunch of similar\n$$ユンボロ$$s around!」

315:2281.en: 「Even if we catch this one, it\nwon't fetch a high price!」

315:2336.en: 「Even women and kids get no mercy!」

315:2371.en: 「That one's unlike the rest...!\nAn ace, huh...!」

315:2420.en: 「Take that one down and we win big!」

315:2453.en: 「Just sink the ship and we've won!」

315:2488.en: 「It's this big! It must be loaded\nwith treasure!」

315:2553.en: 「A ship that dives!? Never seen one!」

315:2711.en: 「That thing...!\nA $$ユンボロ$$ from beyond the sea!」

315:2803.en: 「No way I'll lose on this sea!」

315:3003.en: 「I can't end it being looked down on!」

315:3083.en: 「I'm no man if I just take it!」

315:3151.en: 「If that's how it is, then take this!」

315:3361.en: 「You hit me, I hit back!\nThat's how pirates are!」

315:3480.en: 「If you can't smash it, stand back!」

315:3558.en: 「$$ラケージ$$, leave the rest to me!」

315:3593.en: 「I have to be useful to $$ラケージ$$!」

315:3795.en: 「Hey! What are you doing to $$ラケージ$$!」

315:3907.en: 「Don't you slip up over there either!」

315:4196.en: 「This is the only time I let you off!」

315:4325.en: 「Hate it, but they're a step ahead!」

315:4584.en: 「Slow attacks like that won't hit me!」

315:4619.en: 「Can't screw up in front of $$ラケージ$$!」

315:4724.en: 「I'm a man who delivers when needed!」

315:4790.en: 「A flying $$ユンボロ$$ is no big deal!」

315:4866.en: 「Ships can't move right in the water!」

315:4903.en: 「Amateurs can't beat me in the water!」

315:4940.en: 「Nice moves, but what's the point\nwith an attack like this!」

315:5036.en: 「Time to give up the $$ガンダム$$ name!」

315:5122.en: 「I've got the edge in the water!」

315:5157.en: 「A pirate, lose at sea? No way!」

315:5211.en: 「It hit, but it didn't hit,\nhow about that!」

315:5328.en: 「Come on, don't tell me that's all?」

315:5365.en: 「Looks like I've got nothing to fear」

315:5431.en: 「Feel free to come at me for real」

315:5714.en: 「Don't make me laugh!\nAll looks, no substance!」

315:5969.en: 「Men of the sea can take it!」

315:6004.en: 「I was ready for a scratch like this!」

315:6099.en: 「Junk heap! You're too slow to react!」

315:6204.en: 「Crap! It hit me from the front!」

315:6237.en: 「M-My $$ユンボロ$$ is gonna fall apart!」

315:6272.en: 「What was that just now?!\nI've never seen anything like it!」

315:6329.en: 「Th-That thing...!\nIt came from the outside world?!」

315:6382.en: 「Damn it!\nLike I'd lose to a big-headed jerk!」

315:6431.en: 「That flying $$ユンボロ$$?!\nHow strong is it?!」

315:6719.en: 「I can't keep up with that speed!」

315:6756.en: 「Damn! A fish can't beat a bird!!」

315:6799.en: 「Fast, with heavy firepower, too!\nI don't stand a chance!」

315:6895.en: 「Th-That $$ユンボロ$$...!\nIt's got some strange power!」

315:6995.en: 「That speed?! Is it really a ship?!」

315:7038.en: 「How can a ship move in the sea?!」

315:7077.en: 「The way it fights...!\nIt knows the sea better than we do!」

315:7132.en: 「Damn it! Come down and fight me!」

315:7222.en: 「Lose at sea and I'm no pirate!」

315:7265.en: 「C-Can't I win even in the sea?!」

315:7360.en: 「This is bad! At this rate, I'm...!」

315:7432.en: 「Not good! My $$ユンボロ$$ can't hold out!」

315:7471.en: 「E-Even so,\nthere's got to be a limit!」

315:7524.en: 「No good! This foe is beyond me!」

315:7563.en: 「At this rate I'll end up fish food!」

315:7737.en: 「No good!\nThe $$ユンボロ$$ performance gap is huge!」

315:7788.en: 「I'll slip away at the first chance!」

315:7829.en: 「Tch! Was fighting this one\nthe end of my luck?!」

315:7892.en: 「Crap!\n$$ラケージ$$ will abandon me like this!」

315:7945.en: 「A-At this rate,\nI can't face $$ラケージ$$!」

315:8124.en: 「Not ready to die yet! Bailing out!」

315:8163.en: 「I'll pay you back for this someday!\nRemember that!」

315:8317.en: 「No way I'm dying! I'll try again!」

315:8438.en: 「$$ラケージ$$! I leave the rest to you!」
